'''Ramoa''' was a terrestrial<ref name="FJ" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CER">{{CSWECite|III|77|Ramoan}}</ref> located in the [[Ramoa system/Legends|eponymous star system]], a part of the [[Sprizen sector/Legends|Sprizen sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="Region" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Once, the planet was covered in [[Cloud/Legends|cloud]] [[Forest/Legends|forests]] and was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the hulky, [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Ramoan]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="FJ" />

Following the devastation caused by the [[Yuuzhan Vong War|war]] against<ref name="FJ" /> the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extragalactic]] invaders<ref name="VP">''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]''</ref> the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], the new galactic power, the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], established the [[Reconstruction Authority]]<ref name="JK">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref> to monitor the relocation and rebuilding of civilizations.<ref name="CERC">{{CSWECite|III|86|Reconstruction}}</ref> The Ramoan species lost their home planet in the war<ref name="CER" /> and [[35 ABY/Legends|six years]] after it ended,<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the Reconstruction Authority launched a [[Ramoan relocation project|relocation project]] to evacuate the Ramoan population from their dying world. To accomplish this, a huge Yuuzhan Vong [[slaveship]], the ''[[Maledoth]]'',<ref name="JK" /> which had been used to transport [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] to new homeworlds for many [[Standard year/Legends|years]],<ref name="CERM">{{CSWECite|II|280|Maledoth}}</ref> was employed.<ref name="JK" />

==Behind the scenes==
The planet Ramoa was first mentioned in the novel ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]'', which was written by [[Troy Denning]]<ref name="FJ" /> and released in [[2009]].<ref name="Hardcover">{{SWArchive|url=vault/books/news20090817.html|text=Book Excerpt: ''Star Wars'': Fate of the Jedi: ''Abyss''|archivedate=20090820170351}}</ref> In the same year, ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], placed the [[Ramoa system/Legends|Ramoa star system]] and the planet itself in grid square N-5.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
